data.review_body:
I was a loyal customer with Temu for several years and at first it was pretty good. If there were any issues with items it was easy to receive a refund. Nowadays, it's very difficult to receive a full refund. 

The new returns process has many faults - I was only offered one method of return from a delivery company I am not confident would handle the return efficiently.  From my understanding, if returned products were damaged by the delivery company during the returns delivery process, then no refund would be issued. Because Temu's products are often not good quality and don't meet local standards and safety regulations, there are often one to two items which require a return per order. This is just not sustainable for me as a buyer.

Customer service have become very slow and have limited options to help - the options given are futile and my recent conversations with customer service were left unresolved or with an unsatisfactory outcome. I was drawn into credit back and other offers which were not very transparent on first appearances. Time limits with time differences caused issues with the credit back. 

I thought Temu would improve since they now have local warehouses. I was a loyal customer for years, but have now deleted the app. I would potentially come back to Temu if they improve their returns options, reduce the intensity of misleading offers, their customer service wait time and most importantly the quality of the products that their sellers offer.
data.review_headline: I was a loyal customer but will not buy again
